title: CatalogArchitectureExceptions
description: The catalogue entries that do NOT satisfy CURATION.md admission rule 2 — no build for every supported architecture, and no deliberately labelled official web fallback for the missing one — acknowledged in the repository rather than discovered by a person on the wrong machine. tools/validate_schemas.py fails when an entry is missing an architecture and is not listed here, and fails again when a listing has become untrue, because an acknowledgement that has quietly stopped being true is worse than none.

note.title: Note
note.description: Why this file exists, in prose, for whoever meets it next.

supported_architectures.title: Supported architectures
supported_architectures.description: The architectures Punar builds images for, spelled as the catalogue's source `architectures` arrays spell them.

apps.title: Acknowledged entries
apps.description: Catalogue app id -> what is missing and why. An entry here means the application is ABSENT on that architecture; the shell filters it out rather than offering it and refusing.

missing.title: Missing architectures
missing.description: The supported architectures this entry has no source for.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why neither an architecture-specific build nor a labelled web fallback exists. Required and required to be non-empty: a bare list of ids is a list of things nobody has to justify.
